statistics.claim: Microsoft expected calendar-year 2026 capital expenditure of approximately $175 billion after a shift from finance to operating leases.
Meta expected 2026 capital expenditures, including principal payments on finance leases, of $130 billion to $145 billion, narrowed from $125 billion to $145 billion.
Alphabet expected 2026 capital expenditure of $175 billion to $185 billion as of its fourth quarter 2025 call; the range was later raised (see the second quarter 2026 call).
Amazon free cash flow was $11.2 billion for 2025, down from $38.2 billion for 2024; purchases of property and equipment were $128.3 billion.

Alphabet raised its 2026 capital expenditure guidance to $195 billion to $205 billion from $180 billion to $190 billion, reported second quarter 2026 capital expenditures of $44.9 billion and negative free cash flow of $5.8 billion, and said it expects capital expenditures to increase significantly in 2027.
statistics.limitations: Company guidance; a forecast that can change

statistics.claim: Microsoft expected capital expenditures of over $50 billion in the first quarter of fiscal 2027 and said fiscal 2027 capital expenditures will grow year over year.
statistics.limitations: Company guidance; a forecast that can change

statistics.claim: Meta reported second quarter 2026 capital expenditures of $30.1 billion and free cash flow of $784 million.
Amazon reported purchases of property and equipment, net, of $169.0 billion, operating cash flow of $161.4 billion, and negative free cash flow of $7.6 billion for the twelve months to June 2026.
